usage: Use 新聞 for news as a topic or report. It is a very common everyday noun in both spoken and written Cantonese.
It often appears with verbs like 睇、聽、講、報道, for example when talking about watching news on TV or reading news online.
In Hong Kong, 新聞 can mean news in general, or a news report/item. The meaning depends on context.
This word is neutral and standard, so it works in casual conversation, media, and school settings.
